-- Residential Tenancies Amendment (Rent Cap) Bill 2026 (WA), Bill No. 70,
-- as introduced in the Legislative Council on 7 May 2026 -- clauses 2, 4
-- and proposed s.105. Encoded as the Residential Tenancies Act 1987 would
-- read if the Bill were enacted unamended.
--
-- NOT LAW. The Bill is at second reading in the Legislative Council.
-- Source: LQA/Bill+70-1+(2026).pdf, sha256 35266e07...f30e12; text
-- extracted to LQA/sources/bill-70-1.txt. Act text: registers/
-- source-bundle/mrdoc_49316.txt (retrieved 2026-09-07), CC BY 4.0.
--
-- Findings are numbered B-nn and are written up in LQA/INCIDENTS.md.
-- No library imports: daydate does not resolve on this machine, so days
-- are day-offsets and months are supplied as booleans.

§ `Clause 2 - Commencement`

-- cl.2(b): the operative clauses commence on 1 July 2026 if assent is
-- before that day, otherwise on the day after assent. Offsets are days
-- relative to 1 July 2026 (0 = 1 July 2026, negative = before).

GIVEN `assent day relative to 1 July 2026` IS A NUMBER
GIVETH A NUMBER
DECIDE `commencement day relative to 1 July 2026` IS
    IF `assent day relative to 1 July 2026` LESS THAN 0
    THEN 0
    ELSE `assent day relative to 1 July 2026` PLUS 1

§§ `Clause 2 -- illustrations`

-- B-12: the Bill was introduced on 7 May 2026 and has not passed either
-- House; at 30 September 2026 (offset 91) no assent before 1 July 2026 is
-- still possible, so limb (b)(i) can no longer operate.

#ASSERT `commencement day relative to 1 July 2026` (0 MINUS 30) EQUALS 0
#ASSERT `commencement day relative to 1 July 2026` 91 EQUALS 92

§ `Proposed section 31AA - Limit on increase in rent`

-- The facts of one proposed increase. CPI figures are index numbers
-- exactly as published (the Perth rents subgroup of the housing group).

DECLARE `rent increase proposal` HAS
    `the increase is proposed under section 30` IS A BOOLEAN
    `the increase is proposed under section 31A` IS A BOOLEAN
    `the rent change is made by entering into a new residential tenancy agreement` IS A BOOLEAN
    `the current rent payable` IS A NUMBER
    `the amount of the proposed increase` IS A NUMBER
    `the amount of the proposed increase can be determined when the notice is given` IS A BOOLEAN
    `CPI published most recently before the notice is given` IS A NUMBER
    `CPI published most recently before the agreement commenced` IS A NUMBER
    `the rent payable has been increased previously` IS A BOOLEAN
    `CPI published most recently before notice of the previous increase was given` IS A NUMBER
    `the agreement sets out the amount of the increase or the method of calculating it` IS A BOOLEAN
    `after the notice the tenant agrees to the increase in writing` IS A BOOLEAN
    `a competent court approves the amount of the increase` IS A BOOLEAN
    `the notice states the amount of the proposed increase` IS A BOOLEAN
    `the notice states whether the proposed increase is more than the increase limit` IS A BOOLEAN
    `the notice states that without the tenant's agreement the increase needs court approval` IS A BOOLEAN
    `the notice was given before commencement day` IS A BOOLEAN
    `the tenancy is for a fixed term during its currency` IS A BOOLEAN

§§ `31AA(1) - increase limit`

GIVEN p IS A `rent increase proposal`
GIVETH A NUMBER
DECIDE `initial CPI` IS
    IF p's `the rent payable has been increased previously`
    THEN p's `CPI published most recently before notice of the previous increase was given`
    ELSE p's `CPI published most recently before the agreement commenced`

-- "current CPI" (b): if the most recent CPI is less than the initial CPI,
-- the initial CPI is used, so the increase limit is never negative.

GIVEN p IS A `rent increase proposal`
GIVETH A NUMBER
DECIDE `current CPI` IS
    IF p's `CPI published most recently before the notice is given` LESS THAN `initial CPI` p
    THEN `initial CPI` p
    ELSE p's `CPI published most recently before the notice is given`

@ref Residential Tenancies Amendment (Rent Cap) Bill 2026 (WA) cl.4, proposed s.31AA(1)
@export The increase limit under proposed s.31AA(1): L = R x (current CPI - initial CPI) / initial CPI x 1.1
GIVEN p IS A `rent increase proposal` @desc The proposed increase. Rent amounts in the same unit (for example AUD per week). CPI values are Perth rents-subgroup index numbers as published before the relevant day: before the notice, before the agreement commenced, and (if rent was increased previously) before notice of the previous increase.
GIVETH A NUMBER
DECIDE `the increase limit` IS
    p's `the current rent payable`
        TIMES ((`current CPI` p MINUS `initial CPI` p) DIVIDED BY `initial CPI` p)
        TIMES 1.1

§§ `31AA(2) - when an increase above the limit is allowed`

GIVEN p IS A `rent increase proposal`
GIVETH A BOOLEAN
DECIDE `a section 31AA(2) exception applies` IF
        p's `the agreement sets out the amount of the increase or the method of calculating it`
    OR  p's `after the notice the tenant agrees to the increase in writing`
    OR  p's `a competent court approves the amount of the increase`

-- s.31AA governs only increases "under section 30 or 31A", and proposed
-- s.105 takes out increases whose notice was given before commencement.

GIVEN p IS A `rent increase proposal`
GIVETH A BOOLEAN
DECIDE `section 31AA governs the rent change` IF
        (   p's `the increase is proposed under section 30`
        OR  p's `the increase is proposed under section 31A`
        )
    AND NOT p's `the rent change is made by entering into a new residential tenancy agreement`
    AND NOT p's `the notice was given before commencement day`

@ref Residential Tenancies Amendment (Rent Cap) Bill 2026 (WA) cl.4, proposed s.31AA(2)
@export Decide whether proposed s.31AA(2) allows the amount of a rent increase
GIVEN p IS A `rent increase proposal` @desc The proposed increase. Allowed if s.31AA does not govern the change (a new agreement, or a notice given before commencement), if the amount does not exceed the increase limit, or if an exception applies: the agreement sets out the amount or method of increase, the tenant agreed in writing after the notice, or a competent court approved the amount.
GIVETH A BOOLEAN
DECIDE `the amount of the increase is allowed by section 31AA(2)` IF
        NOT `section 31AA governs the rent change` p
    OR  p's `the amount of the proposed increase` AT MOST `the increase limit` p
    OR  `a section 31AA(2) exception applies` p

§§ `31AA(3) - contents of the notice`

GIVEN p IS A `rent increase proposal`
GIVETH A BOOLEAN
DECIDE `the notice contains the statements required by section 31AA(3)` IF
        p's `the notice states the amount of the proposed increase`
    AND p's `the notice states whether the proposed increase is more than the increase limit`
    AND (
            p's `the amount of the proposed increase` AT MOST `the increase limit` p
        OR  p's `the notice states that without the tenant's agreement the increase needs court approval`
        )

-- B-03: a s.31A notice changes a *method* of calculating income-based
-- rent. Where the resulting amount depends on income not yet known, the
-- amount in s.31AA(3)(a) cannot truthfully be stated, and the comparison
-- with the limit in (3)(b) cannot be made.

GIVEN p IS A `rent increase proposal`
GIVETH A BOOLEAN
DECIDE `section 31AA(3) is capable of being complied with` IF
    p's `the amount of the proposed increase can be determined when the notice is given`

§§ `Interaction with section 30 (fork F-1)`

-- The Bill does not amend s.30(3), which varies the agreement by any
-- notice "given in accordance with this section" (s.30). Whether a notice
-- that breaches s.31AA(2) or (3) still varies the agreement is fork F-1.
-- Reading A (encoded): the s.31AA words "cannot increase" and "must
-- state" make such a notice ineffective as a whole.

GIVEN p IS A `rent increase proposal`
GIVETH A BOOLEAN
DECIDE `the increase takes effect under the amended Act (reading A)` IF
        `the amount of the increase is allowed by section 31AA(2)` p
    AND (
            NOT `section 31AA governs the rent change` p
        OR  `the notice contains the statements required by section 31AA(3)` p
        )

§§ `Section 31AA -- illustrations`

-- Base case: periodic tenancy, $600 a week, CPI up 5% since the last
-- increase notice. L = 600 x 0.05 x 1.1 = 33.

`periodic, within limit` MEANS `rent increase proposal` WITH
    `the increase is proposed under section 30` IS TRUE,
    `the increase is proposed under section 31A` IS FALSE,
    `the rent change is made by entering into a new residential tenancy agreement` IS FALSE,
    `the current rent payable` IS 600,
    `the amount of the proposed increase` IS 30,
    `the amount of the proposed increase can be determined when the notice is given` IS TRUE,
    `CPI published most recently before the notice is given` IS 210,
    `CPI published most recently before the agreement commenced` IS 180,
    `the rent payable has been increased previously` IS TRUE,
    `CPI published most recently before notice of the previous increase was given` IS 200,
    `the agreement sets out the amount of the increase or the method of calculating it` IS FALSE,
    `after the notice the tenant agrees to the increase in writing` IS FALSE,
    `a competent court approves the amount of the increase` IS FALSE,
    `the notice states the amount of the proposed increase` IS TRUE,
    `the notice states whether the proposed increase is more than the increase limit` IS TRUE,
    `the notice states that without the tenant's agreement the increase needs court approval` IS FALSE,
    `the notice was given before commencement day` IS FALSE,
    `the tenancy is for a fixed term during its currency` IS FALSE

`periodic, above limit` MEANS `rent increase proposal` WITH
    `the increase is proposed under section 30` IS TRUE,
    `the increase is proposed under section 31A` IS FALSE,
    `the rent change is made by entering into a new residential tenancy agreement` IS FALSE,
    `the current rent payable` IS 600,
    `the amount of the proposed increase` IS 60,
    `the amount of the proposed increase can be determined when the notice is given` IS TRUE,
    `CPI published most recently before the notice is given` IS 210,
    `CPI published most recently before the agreement commenced` IS 180,
    `the rent payable has been increased previously` IS TRUE,
    `CPI published most recently before notice of the previous increase was given` IS 200,
    `the agreement sets out the amount of the increase or the method of calculating it` IS FALSE,
    `after the notice the tenant agrees to the increase in writing` IS FALSE,
    `a competent court approves the amount of the increase` IS FALSE,
    `the notice states the amount of the proposed increase` IS TRUE,
    `the notice states whether the proposed increase is more than the increase limit` IS TRUE,
    `the notice states that without the tenant's agreement the increase needs court approval` IS TRUE,
    `the notice was given before commencement day` IS FALSE,
    `the tenancy is for a fixed term during its currency` IS FALSE

#ASSERT `the increase limit` `periodic, within limit` EQUALS 33
#ASSERT `the amount of the increase is allowed by section 31AA(2)` `periodic, within limit` EQUALS TRUE
#ASSERT `the amount of the increase is allowed by section 31AA(2)` `periodic, above limit` EQUALS FALSE
#ASSERT `the increase takes effect under the amended Act (reading A)` `periodic, above limit` EQUALS FALSE

-- A falling CPI floors at the initial CPI: the limit is 0, not negative.

`CPI fell` MEANS `rent increase proposal` WITH
    `the increase is proposed under section 30` IS TRUE,
    `the increase is proposed under section 31A` IS FALSE,
    `the rent change is made by entering into a new residential tenancy agreement` IS FALSE,
    `the current rent payable` IS 600,
    `the amount of the proposed increase` IS 30,
    `the amount of the proposed increase can be determined when the notice is given` IS TRUE,
    `CPI published most recently before the notice is given` IS 195,
    `CPI published most recently before the agreement commenced` IS 180,
    `the rent payable has been increased previously` IS TRUE,
    `CPI published most recently before notice of the previous increase was given` IS 200,
    `the agreement sets out the amount of the increase or the method of calculating it` IS FALSE,
    `after the notice the tenant agrees to the increase in writing` IS FALSE,
    `a competent court approves the amount of the increase` IS FALSE,
    `the notice states the amount of the proposed increase` IS TRUE,
    `the notice states whether the proposed increase is more than the increase limit` IS TRUE,
    `the notice states that without the tenant's agreement the increase needs court approval` IS FALSE,
    `the notice was given before commencement day` IS FALSE,
    `the tenancy is for a fixed term during its currency` IS FALSE

#ASSERT `the increase limit` `CPI fell` EQUALS 0

-- B-01: every fixed-term increase escapes the cap. s.30(2)(a) permits an
-- increase during a fixed term only if the agreement sets out the amount
-- or method; that same fact is exception s.31AA(2)(a). A 25% increase
-- written into a fixed-term lease is allowed although L = 33.

`fixed term, 25 percent written into the lease` MEANS `rent increase proposal` WITH
    `the increase is proposed under section 30` IS TRUE,
    `the increase is proposed under section 31A` IS FALSE,
    `the rent change is made by entering into a new residential tenancy agreement` IS FALSE,
    `the current rent payable` IS 600,
    `the amount of the proposed increase` IS 150,
    `the amount of the proposed increase can be determined when the notice is given` IS TRUE,
    `CPI published most recently before the notice is given` IS 210,
    `CPI published most recently before the agreement commenced` IS 180,
    `the rent payable has been increased previously` IS TRUE,
    `CPI published most recently before notice of the previous increase was given` IS 200,
    `the agreement sets out the amount of the increase or the method of calculating it` IS TRUE,
    `after the notice the tenant agrees to the increase in writing` IS FALSE,
    `a competent court approves the amount of the increase` IS FALSE,
    `the notice states the amount of the proposed increase` IS TRUE,
    `the notice states whether the proposed increase is more than the increase limit` IS TRUE,
    `the notice states that without the tenant's agreement the increase needs court approval` IS TRUE,
    `the notice was given before commencement day` IS FALSE,
    `the tenancy is for a fixed term during its currency` IS TRUE

#ASSERT `the amount of the increase is allowed by section 31AA(2)` `fixed term, 25 percent written into the lease` EQUALS TRUE

-- B-01 (periodic limb): the same term in a periodic agreement also
-- switches the cap off; s.82 does not void it because s.31AA(2)(a) is a
-- provision "under this Act".

`periodic, 10 percent annual clause` MEANS `rent increase proposal` WITH
    `the increase is proposed under section 30` IS TRUE,
    `the increase is proposed under section 31A` IS FALSE,
    `the rent change is made by entering into a new residential tenancy agreement` IS FALSE,
    `the current rent payable` IS 600,
    `the amount of the proposed increase` IS 60,
    `the amount of the proposed increase can be determined when the notice is given` IS TRUE,
    `CPI published most recently before the notice is given` IS 210,
    `CPI published most recently before the agreement commenced` IS 180,
    `the rent payable has been increased previously` IS TRUE,
    `CPI published most recently before notice of the previous increase was given` IS 200,
    `the agreement sets out the amount of the increase or the method of calculating it` IS TRUE,
    `after the notice the tenant agrees to the increase in writing` IS FALSE,
    `a competent court approves the amount of the increase` IS FALSE,
    `the notice states the amount of the proposed increase` IS TRUE,
    `the notice states whether the proposed increase is more than the increase limit` IS TRUE,
    `the notice states that without the tenant's agreement the increase needs court approval` IS TRUE,
    `the notice was given before commencement day` IS FALSE,
    `the tenancy is for a fixed term during its currency` IS FALSE

#ASSERT `the increase takes effect under the amended Act (reading A)` `periodic, 10 percent annual clause` EQUALS TRUE

-- B-02: a renewal with the same parties at a higher rent is a new
-- agreement, not an increase "under section 30 or 31A", so the cap does
-- not reach it -- even where s.31B treats it as a continuation for
-- working out when rent was last increased.

`renewal at 20 percent more` MEANS `rent increase proposal` WITH
    `the increase is proposed under section 30` IS FALSE,
    `the increase is proposed under section 31A` IS FALSE,
    `the rent change is made by entering into a new residential tenancy agreement` IS TRUE,
    `the current rent payable` IS 600,
    `the amount of the proposed increase` IS 120,
    `the amount of the proposed increase can be determined when the notice is given` IS TRUE,
    `CPI published most recently before the notice is given` IS 210,
    `CPI published most recently before the agreement commenced` IS 180,
    `the rent payable has been increased previously` IS TRUE,
    `CPI published most recently before notice of the previous increase was given` IS 200,
    `the agreement sets out the amount of the increase or the method of calculating it` IS FALSE,
    `after the notice the tenant agrees to the increase in writing` IS FALSE,
    `a competent court approves the amount of the increase` IS FALSE,
    `the notice states the amount of the proposed increase` IS FALSE,
    `the notice states whether the proposed increase is more than the increase limit` IS FALSE,
    `the notice states that without the tenant's agreement the increase needs court approval` IS FALSE,
    `the notice was given before commencement day` IS FALSE,
    `the tenancy is for a fixed term during its currency` IS FALSE

#ASSERT `section 31AA governs the rent change` `renewal at 20 percent more` EQUALS FALSE
#ASSERT `the increase takes effect under the amended Act (reading A)` `renewal at 20 percent more` EQUALS TRUE

-- B-03: an income-based rent (s.31A). The notice changes the method from
-- 25% to 27% of assessable income; next year's income is unknown, so no
-- amount can be stated.

`income-based method change` MEANS `rent increase proposal` WITH
    `the increase is proposed under section 30` IS FALSE,
    `the increase is proposed under section 31A` IS TRUE,
    `the rent change is made by entering into a new residential tenancy agreement` IS FALSE,
    `the current rent payable` IS 600,
    `the amount of the proposed increase` IS 30,
    `the amount of the proposed increase can be determined when the notice is given` IS FALSE,
    `CPI published most recently before the notice is given` IS 210,
    `CPI published most recently before the agreement commenced` IS 180,
    `the rent payable has been increased previously` IS TRUE,
    `CPI published most recently before notice of the previous increase was given` IS 200,
    `the agreement sets out the amount of the increase or the method of calculating it` IS FALSE,
    `after the notice the tenant agrees to the increase in writing` IS FALSE,
    `a competent court approves the amount of the increase` IS FALSE,
    `the notice states the amount of the proposed increase` IS FALSE,
    `the notice states whether the proposed increase is more than the increase limit` IS TRUE,
    `the notice states that without the tenant's agreement the increase needs court approval` IS FALSE,
    `the notice was given before commencement day` IS FALSE,
    `the tenancy is for a fixed term during its currency` IS FALSE

#ASSERT `section 31AA(3) is capable of being complied with` `income-based method change` EQUALS FALSE
#ASSERT `the increase takes effect under the amended Act (reading A)` `income-based method change` EQUALS FALSE

-- B-04: the formula divides index numbers "published most recently
-- before" two different days. If the ABS re-references the series in
-- between (it did so to 2011-12 = 100), the two numbers are on different
-- bases. Here rents rose 5% in fact, but the series was re-referenced
-- from about 200 to 100: the published current number (105) is below
-- the old-base initial number (200), is floored to it, and L = 0.

`CPI re-referenced between notices` MEANS `rent increase proposal` WITH
    `the increase is proposed under section 30` IS TRUE,
    `the increase is proposed under section 31A` IS FALSE,
    `the rent change is made by entering into a new residential tenancy agreement` IS FALSE,
    `the current rent payable` IS 600,
    `the amount of the proposed increase` IS 30,
    `the amount of the proposed increase can be determined when the notice is given` IS TRUE,
    `CPI published most recently before the notice is given` IS 105,
    `CPI published most recently before the agreement commenced` IS 180,
    `the rent payable has been increased previously` IS TRUE,
    `CPI published most recently before notice of the previous increase was given` IS 200,
    `the agreement sets out the amount of the increase or the method of calculating it` IS FALSE,
    `after the notice the tenant agrees to the increase in writing` IS FALSE,
    `a competent court approves the amount of the increase` IS FALSE,
    `the notice states the amount of the proposed increase` IS TRUE,
    `the notice states whether the proposed increase is more than the increase limit` IS TRUE,
    `the notice states that without the tenant's agreement the increase needs court approval` IS FALSE,
    `the notice was given before commencement day` IS FALSE,
    `the tenancy is for a fixed term during its currency` IS FALSE

#ASSERT `the increase limit` `CPI re-referenced between notices` EQUALS 0
#ASSERT `the amount of the increase is allowed by section 31AA(2)` `CPI re-referenced between notices` EQUALS FALSE

-- Proposed s.105: a notice given before commencement is outside s.31AA.

`notice given before commencement` MEANS `rent increase proposal` WITH
    `the increase is proposed under section 30` IS TRUE,
    `the increase is proposed under section 31A` IS FALSE,
    `the rent change is made by entering into a new residential tenancy agreement` IS FALSE,
    `the current rent payable` IS 600,
    `the amount of the proposed increase` IS 60,
    `the amount of the proposed increase can be determined when the notice is given` IS TRUE,
    `CPI published most recently before the notice is given` IS 210,
    `CPI published most recently before the agreement commenced` IS 180,
    `the rent payable has been increased previously` IS TRUE,
    `CPI published most recently before notice of the previous increase was given` IS 200,
    `the agreement sets out the amount of the increase or the method of calculating it` IS FALSE,
    `after the notice the tenant agrees to the increase in writing` IS FALSE,
    `a competent court approves the amount of the increase` IS FALSE,
    `the notice states the amount of the proposed increase` IS TRUE,
    `the notice states whether the proposed increase is more than the increase limit` IS TRUE,
    `the notice states that without the tenant's agreement the increase needs court approval` IS TRUE,
    `the notice was given before commencement day` IS TRUE,
    `the tenancy is for a fixed term during its currency` IS FALSE

#ASSERT `the amount of the increase is allowed by section 31AA(2)` `notice given before commencement` EQUALS TRUE

§ `Comparison with the ACT model (Residential Tenancies Act 1997 (ACT) s.64B)`

-- The EM says s.31AA "corresponds with the system currently in place in
-- the ACT". s.31AA(2)-(3) track ACT s.64B(1)-(2) nearly word for word,
-- with two differences (sources/act-rta-1997-r84-part5-excerpt.txt):
--   * ACT s.64B(1)(a) exempts only "a fixed term agreement to which
--     section 64A applies" -- one entered into before 10 December 2024.
--     It is a closing transitional. WA s.31AA(2)(a) exempts every
--     agreement, fixed or periodic, for all time (B-01).
--   * ACT s.64AE defines "rental rate increase" to include an increase
--     under an existing or proposed "consecutive tenancy agreement". WA
--     has no counterpart (B-02).

GIVEN `the agreement sets out the increase` IS A BOOLEAN,
      `the agreement is a fixed term agreement entered before the model's cut-off` IS A BOOLEAN
GIVETH A BOOLEAN
DECIDE `the ACT section 64B(1)(a) exception applies` IF
        `the agreement sets out the increase`
    AND `the agreement is a fixed term agreement entered before the model's cut-off`

GIVEN `the agreement sets out the increase` IS A BOOLEAN,
      `the agreement is a fixed term agreement entered before the model's cut-off` IS A BOOLEAN
GIVETH A BOOLEAN
DECIDE `the WA section 31AA(2)(a) exception applies` IF
    `the agreement sets out the increase`

GIVEN `the change is under a new agreement with the same parties` IS A BOOLEAN
GIVETH A BOOLEAN
DECIDE `the ACT cap reaches the change` IF
    TRUE

GIVEN `the change is under a new agreement with the same parties` IS A BOOLEAN
GIVETH A BOOLEAN
DECIDE `the WA cap reaches the change` IF
    NOT `the change is under a new agreement with the same parties`

§§ `ACT comparison -- illustrations`

-- A lease signed after commencement with a 10% annual increase clause.

#ASSERT `the ACT section 64B(1)(a) exception applies` TRUE FALSE EQUALS FALSE
#ASSERT `the WA section 31AA(2)(a) exception applies` TRUE FALSE EQUALS TRUE

-- A renewal with the same tenant at a higher rent.

#ASSERT `the ACT cap reaches the change` TRUE EQUALS TRUE
#ASSERT `the WA cap reaches the change` TRUE EQUALS FALSE

§ `Proposed section 31AB - Lessor's application to increase rent above increase limit`

-- s.31AB(5)-(6): if the court does not approve the increase requested it
-- may order that the rent payable "under the residential tenancy
-- agreement" not exceed a specified amount, for 1 year from the day the
-- order takes effect. s.31AB(8) makes it an offence to demand or receive
-- rent "from the residential premises" above that amount.

DECLARE `rent demand after a section 31AB order` HAS
    `the court made an order under section 31AB(5)` IS A BOOLEAN
    `the maximum rent specified in the order` IS A NUMBER
    `days after the order took effect that the rent is demanded` IS A NUMBER
    `the rent demanded` IS A NUMBER
    `the rent is demanded under the residential tenancy agreement the order was made about` IS A BOOLEAN

GIVEN d IS A `rent demand after a section 31AB order`
GIVETH A BOOLEAN
DECIDE `the section 31AB(5) order is in effect` IF
        d's `the court made an order under section 31AB(5)`
    AND d's `days after the order took effect that the rent is demanded` AT LEAST 0
    AND d's `days after the order took effect that the rent is demanded` LESS THAN 365

-- The order itself limits rent under the agreement it was made about.

GIVEN d IS A `rent demand after a section 31AB order`
GIVETH A BOOLEAN
DECIDE `the order limits the rent demanded` IF
        `the section 31AB(5) order is in effect` d
    AND d's `the rent is demanded under the residential tenancy agreement the order was made about`

@ref Residential Tenancies Amendment (Rent Cap) Bill 2026 (WA) cl.4, proposed s.31AB(8)
@export Decide whether a demand for rent contravenes proposed s.31AB(8) (penalty: fine of $5 000)
GIVEN d IS A `rent demand after a section 31AB order` @desc A demand for or receipt of rent from premises subject to a s.31AB(5) order. Days are counted from the day the order takes effect; the order has effect for 1 year. Offence if the rent demanded exceeds the specified maximum while the order is in effect.
GIVETH A BOOLEAN
DECIDE `section 31AB(8) is contravened` IF
        `the section 31AB(5) order is in effect` d
    AND d's `the rent demanded` GREATER THAN d's `the maximum rent specified in the order`

§§ `Section 31AB -- illustrations`

`demand from the same tenant` MEANS `rent demand after a section 31AB order` WITH
    `the court made an order under section 31AB(5)` IS TRUE,
    `the maximum rent specified in the order` IS 620,
    `days after the order took effect that the rent is demanded` IS 100,
    `the rent demanded` IS 650,
    `the rent is demanded under the residential tenancy agreement the order was made about` IS TRUE

-- B-06: the tenant leaves after 3 months; the lessor lets to a new tenant
-- at $700. The order no longer limits any agreement, yet s.31AB(8) makes
-- demanding $700 "from the residential premises" an offence until the
-- year ends. Compare s.32(5), whose order ends with the tenancy.

`demand from a new tenant` MEANS `rent demand after a section 31AB order` WITH
    `the court made an order under section 31AB(5)` IS TRUE,
    `the maximum rent specified in the order` IS 620,
    `days after the order took effect that the rent is demanded` IS 100,
    `the rent demanded` IS 700,
    `the rent is demanded under the residential tenancy agreement the order was made about` IS FALSE

DECLARE `lessor action` HAS

GIVEN a IS A `lessor action`
GIVETH A BOOLEAN
DECIDE `the lessor takes action of a kind in section 26A(a)` IF
        a's `the lessor gives the tenant a notice claiming the tenant has breached the residential tenancy agreement, other than by failing to pay rent, and requiring the tenant to remedy the breach`
    OR  a's `the lessor increases the rent payable under the residential tenancy agreement`
    OR  a's `the lessor takes action to terminate the residential tenancy agreement`
    OR  a's `at the end of the current residential tenancy agreement, the lessor refuses to enter into a further residential tenancy agreement with the tenant`

@ref Residential Tenancies Act 1987 (WA) s.26A

GIVETH A BOOLEAN

DECLARE `form actor` IS ONE OF

DECLARE `form action` IS ONE OF
    `ensure a written residential tenancy agreement is in the approved form`
    `give a copy of the prescribed information to each tenant`

GIVEN `the lessor has entered into a written residential tenancy agreement` IS A BOOLEAN @desc TRUE if the lessor has entered into a written residential tenancy agreement.
GIVETH A DEONTIC `form actor` `form action`
DECIDE `the written agreement must be in the approved form` IS
    IF `the lessor has entered into a written residential tenancy agreement`
    THEN
        PARTY `the lessor or property manager`
        MUST `ensure a written residential tenancy agreement is in the approved form`
        WITHIN 1
        HENCE FULFILLED
        LEST BREACH BY `the lessor or property manager` BECAUSE "written residential tenancy agreement was not in the approved form (s.27A)"
    ELSE FULFILLED

GIVEN `the agreement is in writing` IS A BOOLEAN @desc TRUE if the residential tenancy agreement is in writing; FALSE if not.
GIVETH A DEONTIC `form actor` `form action`
DECIDE `the prescribed information must be given to each tenant` IS
    IF `the agreement is in writing`
    THEN
        PARTY `the lessor or property manager`
        MUST `give a copy of the prescribed information to each tenant`
        WITHIN 0
        HENCE FULFILLED
        LEST BREACH BY `the lessor or property manager` BECAUSE "prescribed information was not given to each tenant at the time of entering into the written agreement (s.27B(a))"
    ELSE
        PARTY `the lessor or property manager`
        MUST `give a copy of the prescribed information to each tenant`
        WITHIN 14
        HENCE FULFILLED
        LEST BREACH BY `the lessor or property manager` BECAUSE "prescribed information was not given to each tenant within 14 days after the tenant took possession (s.27B(b))"

GIVETH A DEONTIC `form actor` `form action`
`the start of tenancy property condition report must be given` MEANS
    PARTY `the lessor or property manager`
    MUST `prepare a property condition report and provide 2 copies to the tenant`
    WITHIN 7
    HENCE FULFILLED
    LEST BREACH BY `the lessor or property manager` BECAUSE "property condition report was not prepared and 2 copies provided within 7 days after the tenant entered into occupation (s.27C(1))"

GIVETH A DEONTIC `form actor` `form action`
`the final property condition report must be given` MEANS
    PARTY `the lessor or property manager`
    MUST `conduct an inspection, prepare a final report and provide a copy to the tenant`
    WITHIN 14
    HENCE FULFILLED
    LEST BREACH BY `the lessor or property manager` BECAUSE "final property condition report was not provided within 14 days after termination (s.27C(4))"

DECLARE `start of tenancy report` HAS
    `the tenant was given copies of the report` IS A BOOLEAN
    `days after the tenant received the copies` IS A NUMBER
    `the tenant has given a marked copy back to the lessor or property manager` IS A BOOLEAN

@export Decide whether the tenant is taken to accept the start-of-tenancy property condition report

If the tenant does not give a copy back within 7 days of receiving the copies, the tenant is taken to accept the report.

        r's `the tenant was given copies of the report`
    AND NOT r's `the tenant has given a marked copy back to the lessor or property manager`
    AND r's `days after the tenant received the copies` GREATER THAN 7

    `the lessor has maintained the premises in a reasonable state of repair having regard to age and character` IS A BOOLEAN
    `the lessor has conducted any repairs within a reasonable period after the need for the repair arose` IS A BOOLEAN

DECIDE `the tenant is in breach of the cleanliness and damage term` IF
        NOT p's `the tenant has kept the premises in a reasonable state of cleanliness`
    OR  (

        AND NOT p's `the tenant has notified the lessor as soon as practicable after the damage`

DECIDE `the tenant had vacant possession as required` IF
    p's `the tenant had vacant possession of the premises on the day the tenant was entitled to enter into occupation`

GIVETH A BOOLEAN
DECIDE `the lessor is in breach of the cleanliness and repairs term` IF
        NOT p's `the lessor delivered up vacant possession in a reasonable state of cleanliness and a reasonable state of repair having regard to age and character`
    OR  NOT p's `the lessor has maintained the premises in a reasonable state of repair having regard to age and character`
    OR  NOT p's `the lessor has conducted any repairs within a reasonable period after the need for the repair arose`
    OR  NOT p's `the lessor has complied with all requirements in respect of buildings, health and safety under any other written law insofar as they apply to the premises`

DECLARE `urgent repair` HAS
    `the need for urgent repairs arose otherwise than as a result of a breach of the agreement by the tenant` IS A BOOLEAN
    `the tenant has notified the lessor of the need as soon as practicable after the need arose` IS A BOOLEAN
    `the lessor has ensured that the repairs are carried out by a suitable repairer as soon as practicable after that notification` IS A BOOLEAN
    `the repairs are necessary for the supply or restoration of a prescribed essential service` IS A BOOLEAN

    `the tenant has given the lessor a copy of the key` IS A BOOLEAN

GIVEN u IS A `utility charge` @desc The tenant must pay only if the charge is for the tenant's consumption, the consumption is separately metered or calculated by a method agreed in writing, and the lessor has given the s.49A(4) written notice within 30 days of the invoice, unless the tenancy ended within that 30 days or the invoice arrived after the tenancy ended.
GIVETH A BOOLEAN
DECIDE `the tenant must pay the charge for the public utility service` IF
        u's `a public utility service is provided in relation to the premises under a contract between the provider and the lessor or a strata company`
    AND u's `the charge is for the tenant's consumption of the utility at the premises`
    AND (
            u's `the tenant's consumption of the utility is separately metered`
        OR  u's `consumption at the premises is not separately metered but the charge is calculated in accordance with a method previously agreed to in writing by the lessor and the tenant`
        )
    AND (
            u's `the lessor has given the tenant a written notice under section 49A(4) within 30 days after the lessor receives an invoice`
        OR  u's `the tenancy ended within 30 days after the lessor received the invoice or the lessor received the invoice after the tenancy ended`
        )

§ `Part IV - Residential tenancy agreements`

§§ `Division 2A - Standard terms related to keeping pets`

§§§ `50A. Keeping pet at residential premises`

DECLARE `pet request` HAS
    `the animal is an assistance animal` IS A BOOLEAN
    `the lessor has consented` IS A BOOLEAN
    `the request is in the approved form` IS A BOOLEAN
    `days after the lessor received the request` IS A NUMBER
    `the lessor has responded in writing` IS A BOOLEAN
    `the lessor has applied to the Commissioner for approval to refuse the tenant's request under section 50E` IS A BOOLEAN
    `keeping the pet would contravene a written law, local law or scheme bylaws applying to the premises` IS A BOOLEAN
    `the Commissioner has approved the refusal` IS A BOOLEAN
    `a prescribed ground for refusal applies` IS A BOOLEAN

@ref Residential Tenancies Act 1987 (WA) s.50A(3)
@export Decide whether the tenant may keep an assistance animal at the premises without the lessor's consent
GIVEN request IS A `pet request` @desc Set TRUE if the animal is an assistance animal as defined in s.3.
GIVETH A BOOLEAN
DECIDE `the tenant may keep an assistance animal at the premises without the lessor's consent` IF
    request's `the animal is an assistance animal`

GIVEN request IS A `pet request`
GIVETH A BOOLEAN
DECIDE `the lessor is taken to approve the tenant's request to keep a pet` IF
        NOT request's `the animal is an assistance animal`
    AND (
            NOT request's `the lessor has responded in writing`
        OR  NOT request's `the lessor has applied to the Commissioner for approval to refuse the tenant's request under section 50E`
        )
    AND request's `days after the lessor received the request` GREATER THAN 14

@ref Residential Tenancies Act 1987 (WA) s.50D
@export Decide whether the lessor's refusal of consent to keep a pet is on a ground permitted by s.50D
GIVEN request IS A `pet request` @desc The only grounds: keeping the pet would contravene a written law, local law or scheme bylaws; Commissioner approval; or a prescribed ground.
GIVETH A BOOLEAN
DECIDE `the lessor's refusal of consent to keep a pet is permitted` IF
        request's `keeping the pet would contravene a written law, local law or scheme bylaws applying to the premises`
    OR  request's `the Commissioner has approved the refusal`
    OR  request's `a prescribed ground for refusal applies`

@ref Residential Tenancies Act 1987 (WA) s.50A
@export Decide whether the tenant may keep a pet at the premises under s.50A
GIVEN request IS A `pet request` @desc Pet or assistance animal. An assistance animal may be kept without consent. Otherwise the tenant needs the lessor's consent, including consent the lessor is taken to have given if the lessor does not respond in writing within 14 days or does not apply to the Commissioner under s.50E within 14 days.
GIVETH A BOOLEAN
DECIDE `the tenant may keep a pet at the premises` IF
        `the tenant may keep an assistance animal at the premises without the lessor's consent` request
    OR  request's `the lessor has consented`
    OR  `the lessor is taken to approve the tenant's request to keep a pet` request

§§§ `50E. Lessor's application for approval to refuse consent to keep pet at premises`

DECLARE `section 50E application` HAS
    `the premises are unsuitable for keeping the pet` IS A BOOLEAN
    `keeping the pet at the premises would exceed a reasonable number of pets being kept at the premises` IS A BOOLEAN
    `keeping the pet at the premises is likely to cause damage to the premises that could not be repaired for less than the amount of the security bond for the premises` IS A BOOLEAN
    `keeping the pet at the premises would pose an unacceptable risk to the health and safety of a person` IS A BOOLEAN
    `keeping the pet at the premises is likely to cause the lessor undue hardship` IS A BOOLEAN
    `a prescribed ground applies` IS A BOOLEAN

@ref Residential Tenancies Act 1987 (WA) s.50E(3)
@export Decide whether the Commissioner may approve the lessor's refusal of consent to keep a pet under s.50E(3)
GIVEN a IS A `section 50E application` @desc The Commissioner may approve refusal if satisfied the premises are unsuitable, a reasonable number of pets would be exceeded, likely damage could not be repaired for less than the security bond, there is an unacceptable health and safety risk, undue hardship to the lessor, or a prescribed ground.
GIVETH A BOOLEAN
DECIDE `the Commissioner may approve the lessor's refusal of consent to keep a pet` IF
        a's `the premises are unsuitable for keeping the pet`
    OR  a's `keeping the pet at the premises would exceed a reasonable number of pets being kept at the premises`
    OR  a's `keeping the pet at the premises is likely to cause damage to the premises that could not be repaired for less than the amount of the security bond for the premises`
    OR  a's `keeping the pet at the premises would pose an unacceptable risk to the health and safety of a person`
    OR  a's `keeping the pet at the premises is likely to cause the lessor undue hardship`
    OR  a's `a prescribed ground applies`

§§ `Division 2B - Standard terms related to modifications to premises`

§§§ `50J. Tenant may attach furniture to wall for safety of child or person with disability`

DECLARE `furniture safety request` HAS
    `the modification is to attach furniture, or a thing to attach furniture, to a wall of the premises` IS A BOOLEAN
    `the purpose is ensuring the safety of a child or person with disability` IS A BOOLEAN
    `the lessor has consented` IS A BOOLEAN
    `the request is in the approved form` IS A BOOLEAN
    `the request describes the furniture safety modification` IS A BOOLEAN
    `days after the lessor received the request` IS A NUMBER
    `the lessor has responded in writing` IS A BOOLEAN
    `the modification would disturb material containing asbestos` IS A BOOLEAN
    `the premises are entered in the State Register of Heritage Places` IS A BOOLEAN
    `the premises is a lot in a community titles scheme or strata titles scheme and the scheme bylaws prohibit making the modification` IS A BOOLEAN
    `a prescribed ground for refusal applies` IS A BOOLEAN
    `the modification is reasonably required to enable a person with disability to access and use the premises` IS A BOOLEAN
    `refusing consent would be unlawful under the Equal Opportunity Act 1984 section 66L(2)(d) or the Disability Discrimination Act 1992 (Commonwealth) section 25(2)(d)` IS A BOOLEAN

GIVEN request IS A `furniture safety request`
GIVETH A BOOLEAN
DECIDE `the request is a furniture safety modification` IF
        request's `the modification is to attach furniture, or a thing to attach furniture, to a wall of the premises`
    AND request's `the purpose is ensuring the safety of a child or person with disability`

GIVEN request IS A `furniture safety request`
GIVETH A BOOLEAN
DECIDE `the lessor is taken to approve the furniture safety request` IF
        `the request is a furniture safety modification` request
    AND NOT request's `the lessor has responded in writing`
    AND request's `days after the lessor received the request` GREATER THAN 14

@ref Residential Tenancies Act 1987 (WA) s.50L
@export Decide whether the lessor's refusal of a furniture safety modification is on a ground permitted by s.50L
GIVEN request IS A `furniture safety request` @desc The only s.50L(1) grounds: asbestos; State Register of Heritage Places; scheme bylaws prohibit; or a prescribed ground. s.50L(2) then forbids refusal where the modification is reasonably required for disability access and refusing would be unlawful under the Equal Opportunity Act 1984 s.66L(2)(d) or the Disability Discrimination Act 1992 (Cth) s.25(2)(d).
GIVETH A BOOLEAN
DECIDE `the lessor's refusal of a furniture safety modification is permitted` IF
        NOT (
            request's `the modification is reasonably required to enable a person with disability to access and use the premises`
        AND request's `refusing consent would be unlawful under the Equal Opportunity Act 1984 section 66L(2)(d) or the Disability Discrimination Act 1992 (Commonwealth) section 25(2)(d)`
        )
    AND (
            request's `the modification would disturb material containing asbestos`
        OR  request's `the premises are entered in the State Register of Heritage Places`
        OR  request's `the premises is a lot in a community titles scheme or strata titles scheme and the scheme bylaws prohibit making the modification`
        OR  request's `a prescribed ground for refusal applies`
        )

@ref Residential Tenancies Act 1987 (WA) s.50J
@export Decide whether the tenant may make a furniture safety modification under s.50J
GIVEN request IS A `furniture safety request` @desc A proposed attachment of furniture, or a thing to attach furniture, to a wall for the safety of a child or person with disability. Needs lessor consent, including consent the lessor is taken to have given if the lessor does not respond in writing within 14 days.
GIVETH A BOOLEAN
DECIDE `the tenant may make a furniture safety modification` IF
        `the request is a furniture safety modification` request
    AND (
            request's `the lessor has consented`
        OR  `the lessor is taken to approve the furniture safety request` request
        )

§§§ `50M. Tenant may make prescribed modification to prevent entry in circumstances of family violence`

DECLARE `family violence modification` HAS
    `the premises are entered in the State Register of Heritage Places` IS A BOOLEAN
    `the modification is a prescribed modification necessary to prevent a person from entering the residential premises` IS A BOOLEAN
    `the person's interest in the residential tenancy agreement has been terminated under section 60(1)(bc)` IS A BOOLEAN
    `the tenant suspects on reasonable grounds that the person is likely to commit family violence against the tenant or a dependant of the tenant` IS A BOOLEAN
    `the tenant has given the lessor written notice describing the prescribed modification` IS A BOOLEAN
    `the prescribed modification is to be carried out by a suitable tradesperson` IS A BOOLEAN

@ref Residential Tenancies Act 1987 (WA) s.50M
@export Decide whether the tenant may make a prescribed modification to prevent entry in circumstances of family violence without the lessor's consent
GIVEN m IS A `family violence modification` @desc Does not apply if the premises are entered in the State Register of Heritage Places. The tenant may act without consent after a s.60(1)(bc) termination of the person's interest, or if the tenant suspects on reasonable grounds that the person is likely to commit family violence. The tenant must give written notice describing the modification and have it carried out by a suitable tradesperson.
GIVETH A BOOLEAN
DECIDE `the tenant may make a prescribed modification to prevent entry in circumstances of family violence` IF
        NOT m's `the premises are entered in the State Register of Heritage Places`
    AND m's `the modification is a prescribed modification necessary to prevent a person from entering the residential premises`
    AND (
            m's `the person's interest in the residential tenancy agreement has been terminated under section 60(1)(bc)`
        OR  m's `the tenant suspects on reasonable grounds that the person is likely to commit family violence against the tenant or a dependant of the tenant`
        )
    AND m's `the tenant has given the lessor written notice describing the prescribed modification`
    AND m's `the prescribed modification is to be carried out by a suitable tradesperson`

§§§ `50N. Tenant may make minor modification to premises`

DECLARE `minor modification request` HAS
    `the modification is a minor modification` IS A BOOLEAN
    `the lessor has consented` IS A BOOLEAN
    `the request is in the approved form` IS A BOOLEAN
    `the request describes the minor modification` IS A BOOLEAN
    `days after the lessor received the request` IS A NUMBER
    `the lessor has responded in writing` IS A BOOLEAN
    `the lessor has applied to the Commissioner for approval to refuse the tenant's request under section 50S` IS A BOOLEAN
    `making the modification would disturb material containing asbestos` IS A BOOLEAN
    `the premises are entered in the State Register of Heritage Places` IS A BOOLEAN
    `the premises is a lot in a community titles scheme or strata titles scheme and the scheme bylaws prohibit making the modification` IS A BOOLEAN
    `making the modification would be contrary to a written law` IS A BOOLEAN
    `the lessor's refusal is approved by the Commissioner` IS A BOOLEAN
    `a prescribed ground for refusal applies` IS A BOOLEAN
    `the modification is reasonably required to enable a person with disability to access and use the premises` IS A BOOLEAN
    `refusing consent would be unlawful under the Equal Opportunity Act 1984 section 66L(2)(d) or the Disability Discrimination Act 1992 (Commonwealth) section 25(2)(d)` IS A BOOLEAN

GIVEN request IS A `minor modification request`
GIVETH A BOOLEAN
DECIDE `the lessor is taken to approve the minor modification request` IF
        request's `the modification is a minor modification`
    AND NOT request's `the lessor has responded in writing`
    AND NOT request's `the lessor has applied to the Commissioner for approval to refuse the tenant's request under section 50S`
    AND request's `days after the lessor received the request` GREATER THAN 14

@ref Residential Tenancies Act 1987 (WA) s.50Q
@export Decide whether the lessor's refusal of a minor modification is on a ground permitted by s.50Q
GIVEN request IS A `minor modification request` @desc The only s.50Q grounds: asbestos; State Register of Heritage Places; scheme bylaws prohibit; contrary to a written law; Commissioner approval; or a prescribed ground. s.50R forbids refusal where the modification is reasonably required for disability access and refusing would be unlawful under the Equal Opportunity Act 1984 s.66L(2)(d) or the Disability Discrimination Act 1992 (Cth) s.25(2)(d).
GIVETH A BOOLEAN
DECIDE `the lessor's refusal of a minor modification is permitted` IF
        NOT (
            request's `the modification is reasonably required to enable a person with disability to access and use the premises`
        AND request's `refusing consent would be unlawful under the Equal Opportunity Act 1984 section 66L(2)(d) or the Disability Discrimination Act 1992 (Commonwealth) section 25(2)(d)`
        )
    AND (
            request's `making the modification would disturb material containing asbestos`
        OR  request's `the premises are entered in the State Register of Heritage Places`
        OR  request's `the premises is a lot in a community titles scheme or strata titles scheme and the scheme bylaws prohibit making the modification`
        OR  request's `making the modification would be contrary to a written law`
        OR  request's `the lessor's refusal is approved by the Commissioner`
        OR  request's `a prescribed ground for refusal applies`
        )

@ref Residential Tenancies Act 1987 (WA) s.50N
@export Decide whether the tenant may make a minor modification under s.50N
GIVEN request IS A `minor modification request` @desc A minor modification as prescribed. Needs lessor consent, including consent the lessor is taken to have given if the lessor neither responds in writing nor applies to the Commissioner under s.50S within 14 days.
GIVETH A BOOLEAN
DECIDE `the tenant may make a minor modification` IF
        request's `the modification is a minor modification`
    AND (
            request's `the lessor has consented`
        OR  `the lessor is taken to approve the minor modification request` request
        )

@ref Residential Tenancies Act 1987 (WA) s.71(1)
@export Decide whether the lessor may apply under s.71 for termination and possession
GIVEN a IS A `section 71 application` @desc Notice of termination under this Act except s.70A; tenant failed to deliver up possession on the specified day; application within 30 days after that day; not blocked by s.62(5)(a) (immediate rent notice with rent paid in full before the specified day).
GIVETH A BOOLEAN
DECIDE `the lessor may apply under section 71` IF
        a's `the lessor or a tenant has given notice of termination to the other under this Act`
    AND NOT a's `the notice was given under section 70A`
    AND a's `the tenant failed to deliver up possession of the premises on the day specified`
    AND a's `days after the day specified` AT MOST 30
    AND a's `days after the day specified` AT LEAST 0
    AND NOT a's `the notice of termination was given immediately the rent breach occurred and the rent due is paid in full before the day specified`

GIVEN a IS A `section 71 application`
GIVETH A BOOLEAN
DECIDE `the court is satisfied of the matters in section 71(2)` IF
        a's `the notice complied with and was given in accordance with this Act`
    AND (
            NOT a's `the notice was given by the lessor upon a particular ground prescribed by this Act`
        OR  (
                a's `the notice was given by a lessor on a ground referred to in section 71C or 71H`
            AND a's `any notice required to be given under section 71F or 71I before giving notice of termination was given in accordance with that section`
            AND a's `any review required to be carried out under section 71F or 71I was carried out in accordance with that section`
            AND (
                    a's `the tenant is not eligible to reside in social housing premises or in the class of social housing premises to which the agreement relates under the criteria approved under section 71E`
                OR  a's `the lessor has offered to enter into a new social housing tenancy agreement with the tenant in respect of alternative premises that are available for occupation by the tenant`
                )
            )
        OR  (
                a's `the lessor has established that ground`
            AND (
                    NOT a's `the notice was upon the ground of a breach by the tenant of a term of the agreement`
                OR  a's `the breach is in all the circumstances such as to justify termination of the agreement`
                )
            )
        )

GIVEN a IS A `section 71 application`
GIVETH A BOOLEAN
DECIDE `the court may refuse to make the orders under section 71(3)(b)` IF
        a's `giving the notice is retaliatory action taken by the lessor against the tenant because of a matter mentioned in section 26B(2)(a), (b) or (c)`
    OR  (
            a's `the notice was upon the ground of a breach by the tenant of a term of the agreement`
        AND a's `the tenant has remedied the breach`
        )
    OR  (
            a's `the notice was given by the lessor upon the ground referred to in section 69`
        AND a's `the consequences of the lessor continuing to be bound by the agreement would not be unduly burdensome to the lessor`
        )

@ref Residential Tenancies Act 1987 (WA) s.71(2)
@export Decide whether the court shall make orders terminating the agreement and for possession under s.71(2)
GIVEN a IS A `section 71 application` @desc Subject to s.71(3), the court shall make the orders if satisfied the notice complied with this Act and, where given on a prescribed ground other than s.71C or 71H, that the lessor has established the ground (and for breach, that the breach justifies termination). The court may refuse if the notice is retaliatory, the tenant has remedied a breach, or a s.69 notice would not be unduly burdensome.
GIVETH A BOOLEAN
DECIDE `the court shall make orders terminating the agreement and for possession under section 71` IF
        `the lessor may apply under section 71` a
    AND `the court is satisfied of the matters in section 71(2)` a
    AND NOT `the court may refuse to make the orders under section 71(3)(b)` a

GIVEN a IS A `section 71 application`
GIVETH A BOOLEAN
DECIDE `the burden lies on the lessor to prove that the lessor was not wholly or partly motivated to give notice by the tenant's complaint or enforcement steps` IF
        a's `within the period of 6 months before notice was given by the lessor the tenant complained to a public authority or took steps to secure or enforce the tenant's rights as a tenant`
    AND NOT a's `the lessor has proved that the lessor was not wholly or partly motivated to give notice by that fact`

DECLARE `section 72 application` HAS

@ref Residential Tenancies Act 1987 (WA) s.72

The court shall make the orders, but must refuse where the term is less than 90 days unless the lessor genuinely proposed an inconsistent use at entry or the tenant of the tenant's own initiative sought a term of less than 90 days. That 90-day refusal does not apply where the premises are the lessor's principal place of residence.
GIVETH A BOOLEAN
