§§ `Division 1 - How residential tenancy agreements are terminated`

§§§ `60. How residential tenancy agreements and tenant's interests in agreements are terminated`

-- Facts for the exhaustive list in s.60(1). Limbs (ba), (bb) and (bc)
-- terminate a particular tenant's interest, not the agreement.

DECLARE `termination circumstances` HAS
    `the lessor or tenant gives notice of termination under this Act` IS A BOOLEAN
    `the tenant delivers up vacant possession of the premises on or after the expiration of the period of notice required under this Act` IS A BOOLEAN
    `a competent court upon application by the lessor terminates the agreement under section 71` IS A BOOLEAN
    `the tenancy is for a fixed term` IS A BOOLEAN
    `the lessor or tenant gives a notice of termination under section 70A` IS A BOOLEAN
    `the tenant delivers up possession of the premises on or after the day on which the term of the agreement expires in accordance with section 70A` IS A BOOLEAN
    `a competent court upon application by the lessor terminates the agreement under section 72` IS A BOOLEAN
    `the tenant gives notice under section 71AB(1) of termination of the tenant's interest together with at least 1 of the documents required under section 71AB(2)` IS A BOOLEAN
    `the tenant vacates the premises on or after the expiration of the period of notice required under section 71AB(5)` IS A BOOLEAN
    `the tenant gives notice under section 71AD(4) of termination of the tenant's interest` IS A BOOLEAN
    `the tenant vacates the premises on or after the expiration of the period of notice required under section 71AD(5)` IS A BOOLEAN
    `a competent court terminates the tenant's interest under section 71AE` IS A BOOLEAN
    `a competent court terminates the agreement under section 73, 74, 75A or 75` IS A BOOLEAN
    `a person having superior title to that of the lessor becomes entitled to possession of the premises` IS A BOOLEAN
    `a mortgagee in respect of the premises takes possession of the premises in pursuance of the mortgage` IS A BOOLEAN
    `the tenant abandons the premises` IS A BOOLEAN
    `the tenant delivers up vacant possession of the premises pursuant to an agreement in writing between the lessor and the tenant to terminate the residential tenancy agreement` IS A BOOLEAN
    `the agreement terminates by merger` IS A BOOLEAN
    `every tenant dies` IS A BOOLEAN

GIVEN c IS A `termination circumstances`
GIVETH A BOOLEAN
DECIDE `section 60(1)(a) applies` IF
        c's `the lessor or tenant gives notice of termination under this Act`
    AND (
            c's `the tenant delivers up vacant possession of the premises on or after the expiration of the period of notice required under this Act`
        OR  c's `a competent court upon application by the lessor terminates the agreement under section 71`
        )

GIVEN c IS A `termination circumstances`
GIVETH A BOOLEAN
DECIDE `section 60(1)(b) applies` IF
        c's `the tenancy is for a fixed term`
    AND c's `the lessor or tenant gives a notice of termination under section 70A`
    AND (
            c's `the tenant delivers up possession of the premises on or after the day on which the term of the agreement expires in accordance with section 70A`
        OR  c's `a competent court upon application by the lessor terminates the agreement under section 72`
        )

GIVEN c IS A `termination circumstances`
GIVETH A BOOLEAN
DECIDE `section 60(1)(ba) applies` IF
        c's `the tenant gives notice under section 71AB(1) of termination of the tenant's interest together with at least 1 of the documents required under section 71AB(2)`
    AND c's `the tenant vacates the premises on or after the expiration of the period of notice required under section 71AB(5)`

GIVEN c IS A `termination circumstances`
GIVETH A BOOLEAN
DECIDE `section 60(1)(bb) applies` IF
        c's `the tenant gives notice under section 71AD(4) of termination of the tenant's interest`
    AND c's `the tenant vacates the premises on or after the expiration of the period of notice required under section 71AD(5)`

GIVEN c IS A `termination circumstances`
GIVETH A BOOLEAN
DECIDE `section 60(1)(bc) applies` IF
    c's `a competent court terminates the tenant's interest under section 71AE`

@ref Residential Tenancies Act 1987 (WA) s.60(1)
@export Decide whether a residential tenancy agreement is terminated under s.60(1)
GIVEN c IS A `termination circumstances` @desc The s.60(1) facts. Limbs (a) to (i) can terminate the agreement. Limbs (ba), (bb) and (bc) terminate a particular tenant's interest only -- use "a particular tenant's interest is terminated". Set only the facts that occurred.
GIVETH A BOOLEAN
DECIDE `the residential tenancy agreement is terminated` IF
        `section 60(1)(a) applies` c
    OR  `section 60(1)(b) applies` c
    OR  c's `a competent court terminates the agreement under section 73, 74, 75A or 75`
    OR  c's `a person having superior title to that of the lessor becomes entitled to possession of the premises`
    OR  c's `a mortgagee in respect of the premises takes possession of the premises in pursuance of the mortgage`
    OR  c's `the tenant abandons the premises`
    OR  c's `the tenant delivers up vacant possession of the premises pursuant to an agreement in writing between the lessor and the tenant to terminate the residential tenancy agreement`
    OR  c's `the agreement terminates by merger`
    OR  c's `every tenant dies`

@ref Residential Tenancies Act 1987 (WA) s.60(1)(ba)-(bc)
@export Decide whether a particular tenant's interest is terminated under s.60(1)(ba), (bb) or (bc)
GIVEN c IS A `termination circumstances` @desc The same s.60(1) facts. TRUE only for family-violence interest termination under s.71AB, s.71AD(4) or s.71AE. s.60(2) then keeps the agreement on foot for any other tenant.
GIVETH A BOOLEAN
DECIDE `a particular tenant's interest is terminated` IF
        `section 60(1)(ba) applies` c
    OR  `section 60(1)(bb) applies` c
    OR  `section 60(1)(bc) applies` c

-- s.60(2): termination of a tenant's interest does not terminate the
-- agreement in respect of any other tenant under the agreement.

GIVEN c IS A `termination circumstances`
GIVETH A BOOLEAN
DECIDE `the agreement remains in force in respect of any other tenant` IF
        `a particular tenant's interest is terminated` c
    AND NOT `the residential tenancy agreement is terminated` c

§§ `Division 2 - Notices of termination`

§§§ `61. Form of notice of termination by lessor`

DECLARE `lessor notice of termination` HAS
    `the notice is in writing` IS A BOOLEAN
    `the notice is in the prescribed form` IS A BOOLEAN
    `the notice is signed by the lessor or a property manager of the residential premises` IS A BOOLEAN
    `the notice identifies the premises the subject of the agreement` IS A BOOLEAN
    `the notice specifies the day on which possession of the premises is to be delivered up by the tenant` IS A BOOLEAN
    `the notice specifies and gives particulars of the ground if any upon which the notice is given` IS A BOOLEAN
    `the tenancy is for a fixed term during the currency of that term` IS A BOOLEAN
    `days of notice before possession is required` IS A NUMBER
    `the tenant has breached a term of the agreement` IS A BOOLEAN
    `the breach has not been remedied` IS A BOOLEAN
    `the breach is of the agreement to pay rent` IS A BOOLEAN
    `a notice specifying the breach and requiring that it be remedied was given not less than 14 days before the notice of termination` IS A BOOLEAN
    `a notice specifying the breach and requiring payment of the rent was given not less than 14 days before the notice of termination` IS A BOOLEAN
    `the notice of termination was given immediately the rent breach occurred` IS A BOOLEAN
    `the lessor has entered into a contract for the sale of the premises` IS A BOOLEAN
    `under that contract the lessor is required to give vacant possession of the premises` IS A BOOLEAN
    `the person giving the notice knows it is false or misleading in a material particular` IS A BOOLEAN
    `proceedings are pending for an order or an order is in force under section 32` IS A BOOLEAN
    `a competent court has authorised the lessor to give notice of termination under section 65(2)` IS A BOOLEAN
    `the premises or a part of the premises are destroyed or rendered uninhabitable or cease to be lawfully usable as a residence or are appropriated or acquired by any authority by compulsory process` IS A BOOLEAN
    `that occurred as a result of a breach of the residential tenancy agreement` IS A BOOLEAN

@ref Residential Tenancies Act 1987 (WA) s.61
@export Decide whether a lessor's notice of termination is in the form required by s.61
GIVEN notice IS A `lessor notice of termination` @desc The lessor's notice: writing; prescribed form; signed by the lessor or a property manager; identifies the premises; specifies the possession day; and specifies and gives particulars of the ground, if any.
GIVETH A BOOLEAN
DECIDE `the lessor's notice of termination is in the form required by section 61` IF
        notice's `the notice is in writing`
    AND notice's `the notice is in the prescribed form`
    AND notice's `the notice is signed by the lessor or a property manager of the residential premises`
    AND notice's `the notice identifies the premises the subject of the agreement`
    AND notice's `the notice specifies the day on which possession of the premises is to be delivered up by the tenant`
    AND notice's `the notice specifies and gives particulars of the ground if any upon which the notice is given`

§§§ `62. Notice of termination by lessor upon ground of breach of term of agreement`

GIVEN notice IS A `lessor notice of termination`
GIVETH A BOOLEAN
DECIDE `the prior notice required by section 62 has been given` IF
    IF notice's `the breach is of the agreement to pay rent`
    THEN (
            notice's `a notice specifying the breach and requiring payment of the rent was given not less than 14 days before the notice of termination`
        OR  notice's `the notice of termination was given immediately the rent breach occurred`
        )
    ELSE notice's `a notice specifying the breach and requiring that it be remedied was given not less than 14 days before the notice of termination`

-- s.65(1)(b): a lessor notice other than a s.64 notice is ineffectual
-- while s.32 is on foot, unless first authorised under s.65(2).

GIVEN notice IS A `lessor notice of termination`
GIVETH A BOOLEAN
DECIDE `section 65(1)(b) makes the lessor's notice ineffectual` IF
        notice's `proceedings are pending for an order or an order is in force under section 32`
    AND NOT notice's `a competent court has authorised the lessor to give notice of termination under section 65(2)`

@ref Residential Tenancies Act 1987 (WA) s.62
@export Decide whether a lessor's notice of termination upon breach of a term is effectual under s.62
GIVEN notice IS A `lessor notice of termination` @desc Lessor notice on the ground that the tenant has breached a term and the breach has not been remedied. Period of notice must be at least 7 days. For a non-rent breach, a 14-day remedy notice must precede the termination notice. For rent, either that 14-day rent notice or an immediate s.62(5) notice. Also supply s.61 form facts and any s.32 / s.65 facts.
GIVETH A BOOLEAN
DECIDE `the lessor's notice upon breach is effectual` IF
        `the lessor's notice of termination is in the form required by section 61` notice
    AND notice's `the tenant has breached a term of the agreement`
    AND notice's `the breach has not been remedied`
    AND notice's `days of notice before possession is required` AT LEAST 7
    AND `the prior notice required by section 62 has been given` notice
    AND NOT `section 65(1)(b) makes the lessor's notice ineffectual` notice

DECLARE `section 62(5) application` HAS
    `the notice of termination was given immediately the rent breach occurred` IS A BOOLEAN
    `the rent due under the agreement is paid in full before the day specified as the day on which the tenant is to deliver up possession` IS A BOOLEAN
    `the rent due and any fee paid by the lessor under section 18(1) are paid in full to the lessor not less than one day before the hearing` IS A BOOLEAN
    `the hearing of the application under section 71 takes place not less than 21 days after notice is given` IS A BOOLEAN

GIVEN a IS A `section 62(5) application`
GIVETH A BOOLEAN
DECIDE `the lessor shall not make an application under section 71` IF
        a's `the notice of termination was given immediately the rent breach occurred`
    AND a's `the rent due under the agreement is paid in full before the day specified as the day on which the tenant is to deliver up possession`

GIVEN a IS A `section 62(5) application`
GIVETH A BOOLEAN
DECIDE `the lessor shall not continue proceedings in respect of an application under section 71` IF
        a's `the notice of termination was given immediately the rent breach occurred`
    AND a's `the rent due and any fee paid by the lessor under section 18(1) are paid in full to the lessor not less than one day before the hearing`

GIVEN a IS A `section 62(5) application`
GIVETH A BOOLEAN
DECIDE `an order under section 71(2) is of no effect` IF
        `the lessor shall not make an application under section 71` a
    OR  `the lessor shall not continue proceedings in respect of an application under section 71` a
    OR  (
            a's `the notice of termination was given immediately the rent breach occurred`
        AND NOT a's `the hearing of the application under section 71 takes place not less than 21 days after notice is given`
        )

-- s.62(7): holding over at the end of a fixed term is not a breach.

GIVEN `the agreement creates a tenancy for a fixed term` IS A BOOLEAN @desc TRUE if the residential tenancy agreement creates a tenancy for a fixed term.
      `the tenant failed to deliver up vacant possession at the expiration of the term` IS A BOOLEAN @desc TRUE if the tenant did not deliver up vacant possession at the expiration of that term.
GIVETH A BOOLEAN
DECIDE `the tenant's failure to deliver up vacant possession at the expiration of the term constitutes a breach of the agreement` IF
        `the agreement creates a tenancy for a fixed term`
    AND `the tenant failed to deliver up vacant possession at the expiration of the term`
    AND FALSE

§§§ `63. Notice of termination by lessor who has entered into contract of sale`

@ref Residential Tenancies Act 1987 (WA) s.63
@export Decide whether a lessor's notice of termination on the ground of a contract of sale is effectual under s.63
GIVEN notice IS A `lessor notice of termination` @desc Lessor notice on the ground that the lessor has entered into a contract for sale of the premises requiring vacant possession. Period of notice must be at least 30 days. Does not apply during a fixed term. A notice the giver knows is false or misleading is not effectual here. Also supply s.61 form facts and any s.32 / s.65 facts.
GIVETH A BOOLEAN
DECIDE `the lessor's notice on contract of sale is effectual` IF
        `the lessor's notice of termination is in the form required by section 61` notice
    AND NOT notice's `the tenancy is for a fixed term during the currency of that term`
    AND notice's `the lessor has entered into a contract for the sale of the premises`
    AND notice's `under that contract the lessor is required to give vacant possession of the premises`
    AND NOT notice's `the person giving the notice knows it is false or misleading in a material particular`
    AND notice's `days of notice before possession is required` AT LEAST 30
    AND NOT `section 65(1)(b) makes the lessor's notice ineffectual` notice

§§§ `64. Notice of termination by lessor without any ground`

-- s.65(1)(a): a s.64 notice is ineffectual while s.32 is on foot.
-- There is no s.65(2) authorisation exception for a s.64 notice.

GIVEN notice IS A `lessor notice of termination`
GIVETH A BOOLEAN
DECIDE `section 65(1)(a) makes the lessor's notice ineffectual` IF
    notice's `proceedings are pending for an order or an order is in force under section 32`

@ref Residential Tenancies Act 1987 (WA) s.64
@export Decide whether a lessor's notice of termination without any ground is effectual under s.64
GIVEN notice IS A `lessor notice of termination` @desc Lessor notice without specifying any ground. Period of notice must be at least 60 days. Does not apply during a fixed term. Ineffectual if s.32 proceedings are pending or an s.32 order is in force. Also supply s.61 form facts.
GIVETH A BOOLEAN
DECIDE `the lessor's notice without any ground is effectual` IF
        `the lessor's notice of termination is in the form required by section 61` notice
    AND NOT notice's `the tenancy is for a fixed term during the currency of that term`
    AND notice's `days of notice before possession is required` AT LEAST 60
    AND NOT `section 65(1)(a) makes the lessor's notice ineffectual` notice

§§§ `66. Notice by lessor not waived by acceptance of rent`

@ref Residential Tenancies Act 1987 (WA) s.66
@export Decide whether a lessor's demand, proceeding for recovery, or acceptance of rent after notice of a breach or after giving notice of termination operates as a waiver
GIVEN `the lessor has demanded, proceeded for recovery of, or accepted rent after notice of a breach by the tenant or after giving notice of termination` IS A BOOLEAN @desc TRUE if, after the lessor has notice of a breach by the tenant or has given the tenant notice of termination under this Act, the lessor demands rent, proceeds to recover rent, or accepts rent.
GIVETH A BOOLEAN
DECIDE `that demand proceeding or acceptance operates as a waiver of that breach or that notice` IF
        `the lessor has demanded, proceeded for recovery of, or accepted rent after notice of a breach by the tenant or after giving notice of termination`
    AND FALSE

§§§ `67. Form of notice of termination by tenant`

DECLARE `tenant notice of termination` HAS
    `the notice is given under section 71AB(1)` IS A BOOLEAN
    `the notice is in writing` IS A BOOLEAN
    `the notice is in a prescribed form` IS A BOOLEAN
    `the notice is signed by the tenant` IS A BOOLEAN
    `the notice identifies the premises the subject of the agreement` IS A BOOLEAN
    `the notice specifies the day on which the tenant will deliver up possession of the premises` IS A BOOLEAN
    `the tenancy is for a fixed term during the currency of that term` IS A BOOLEAN
    `days of notice before the termination day` IS A NUMBER
    `the premises or a part of the premises are destroyed or rendered uninhabitable or cease to be lawfully usable as a residence or are appropriated or acquired by any authority by compulsory process` IS A BOOLEAN
    `that occurred as a result of a breach of the residential tenancy agreement` IS A BOOLEAN

@ref Residential Tenancies Act 1987 (WA) s.67
@export Decide whether a tenant's notice of termination is in the form required by s.67
GIVEN notice IS A `tenant notice of termination` @desc The tenant's notice. A s.71AB(1) family-violence notice must be in a prescribed form. Any other tenant notice must be in writing, signed by the tenant, identify the premises, and specify the day the tenant will deliver up possession.
GIVETH A BOOLEAN
DECIDE `the tenant's notice of termination is in the form required by section 67` IF
    IF notice's `the notice is given under section 71AB(1)`
    THEN notice's `the notice is in a prescribed form`
    ELSE (
            notice's `the notice is in writing`
        AND notice's `the notice is signed by the tenant`
        AND notice's `the notice identifies the premises the subject of the agreement`
        AND notice's `the notice specifies the day on which the tenant will deliver up possession of the premises`
        )

§§§ `68. Notice of termination by tenant`

@ref Residential Tenancies Act 1987 (WA) s.68
@export Decide whether a tenant's notice of termination without any ground is effectual under s.68
GIVEN notice IS A `tenant notice of termination` @desc Tenant notice without specifying any ground. Period of notice must be at least 21 days before the termination day. Does not apply during a fixed term. Also supply s.67 form facts (not a s.71AB(1) notice).
GIVETH A BOOLEAN
DECIDE `the tenant's notice without any ground is effectual` IF
        `the tenant's notice of termination is in the form required by section 67` notice
    AND NOT notice's `the notice is given under section 71AB(1)`
    AND NOT notice's `the tenancy is for a fixed term during the currency of that term`
    AND notice's `days of notice before the termination day` AT LEAST 21

§§§ `69. Notice of termination by lessor or tenant where agreement frustrated`

DECLARE `premises frustration` HAS
    `the premises or a part of the premises are destroyed or rendered uninhabitable or cease to be lawfully usable as a residence or are appropriated or acquired by any authority by compulsory process` IS A BOOLEAN
    `that occurred as a result of a breach of the residential tenancy agreement` IS A BOOLEAN

@ref Residential Tenancies Act 1987 (WA) s.69(1)(a)
@export Decide whether rent shall abate under s.69(1)(a)
GIVEN event IS A `premises frustration` @desc Whether, otherwise than as a result of a breach of the residential tenancy agreement, the premises or a part of them are destroyed, uninhabitable, cease to be lawfully usable as a residence, or are appropriated or acquired by compulsory process.
GIVETH A BOOLEAN
DECIDE `the rent shall abate accordingly` IF
        event's `the premises or a part of the premises are destroyed or rendered uninhabitable or cease to be lawfully usable as a residence or are appropriated or acquired by any authority by compulsory process`
    AND NOT event's `that occurred as a result of a breach of the residential tenancy agreement`

@ref Residential Tenancies Act 1987 (WA) s.69
@export Decide whether a lessor's notice of termination where the agreement is frustrated is effectual under s.69
GIVEN notice IS A `lessor notice of termination` @desc Lessor notice on the ground that, otherwise than as a result of a breach, the premises (or part) are destroyed, uninhabitable, cease to be lawfully usable as a residence, or are compulsorily acquired. Period of notice must be at least 7 days. Not ineffectual merely because possession day is before the last day of a fixed term. Also supply s.61 form facts and any s.32 / s.65 facts.
GIVETH A BOOLEAN
DECIDE `the lessor's notice where the agreement is frustrated is effectual` IF
        `the lessor's notice of termination is in the form required by section 61` notice
    AND notice's `the premises or a part of the premises are destroyed or rendered uninhabitable or cease to be lawfully usable as a residence or are appropriated or acquired by any authority by compulsory process`
    AND NOT notice's `that occurred as a result of a breach of the residential tenancy agreement`
    AND notice's `days of notice before possession is required` AT LEAST 7
    AND NOT `section 65(1)(b) makes the lessor's notice ineffectual` notice

@ref Residential Tenancies Act 1987 (WA) s.69
@export Decide whether a tenant's notice of termination where the agreement is frustrated is effectual under s.69
GIVEN notice IS A `tenant notice of termination` @desc Tenant notice on the same frustration ground. Period of notice must be at least 2 days before the termination day. Not ineffectual merely because possession day is before the last day of a fixed term. Also supply s.67 form facts.
GIVETH A BOOLEAN
DECIDE `the tenant's notice where the agreement is frustrated is effectual` IF
        `the tenant's notice of termination is in the form required by section 67` notice
    AND NOT notice's `the notice is given under section 71AB(1)`
    AND notice's `the premises or a part of the premises are destroyed or rendered uninhabitable or cease to be lawfully usable as a residence or are appropriated or acquired by any authority by compulsory process`
    AND NOT notice's `that occurred as a result of a breach of the residential tenancy agreement`
    AND notice's `days of notice before the termination day` AT LEAST 2

§§§ `70A. Notice of termination by lessor or tenant at end of fixed term tenancy`

-- Offsets are days relative to the expiry day: 0 is the expiry day,
-- a positive number is that many days after expiry, a negative number
-- is before expiry.

DECLARE `end of fixed term notices` HAS
    `the lessor has given a notice of termination specifying a possession day` IS A BOOLEAN
    `days before the lessor's possession day that the lessor's notice was given` IS A NUMBER
    `lessor's possession day relative to the expiry day` IS A NUMBER
    `the tenant has given a notice of termination specifying a possession day` IS A BOOLEAN
    `days before the tenant's possession day that the tenant's notice was given` IS A NUMBER
    `tenant's possession day relative to the expiry day` IS A NUMBER
    `the tenant delivered up possession of the premises after the expiry day but before the lessor's possession day` IS A BOOLEAN
    `days after the expiry day that the tenant delivered up possession` IS A NUMBER

GIVEN n IS A `end of fixed term notices`
GIVETH A BOOLEAN
DECIDE `the lessor's section 70A notice is given in time and not earlier than the expiry day` IF
        n's `the lessor has given a notice of termination specifying a possession day`
    AND n's `days before the lessor's possession day that the lessor's notice was given` AT LEAST 30
    AND n's `lessor's possession day relative to the expiry day` AT LEAST 0

GIVEN n IS A `end of fixed term notices`
GIVETH A BOOLEAN
DECIDE `the tenant's section 70A notice is given in time and not earlier than the expiry day` IF
        n's `the tenant has given a notice of termination specifying a possession day`
    AND n's `days before the tenant's possession day that the tenant's notice was given` AT LEAST 30
    AND n's `tenant's possession day relative to the expiry day` AT LEAST 0

@ref Residential Tenancies Act 1987 (WA) s.70A
@export Decide whether a notice of termination under s.70A has been given so that the fixed term can end
GIVEN n IS A `end of fixed term notices` @desc Fixed-term end notices. Offsets are days relative to the expiry day (0 = expiry day; positive = after expiry). Each party's notice must be given at least 30 days before its possession day, and that possession day must not be earlier than the expiry day. If both give notices, the earlier possession day is used. If the tenant delivers up after expiry but before the lessor's possession day, that delivery day is the possession day.
GIVETH A BOOLEAN
DECIDE `a notice of termination under section 70A has been given` IF
        `the lessor's section 70A notice is given in time and not earlier than the expiry day` n
    OR  `the tenant's section 70A notice is given in time and not earlier than the expiry day` n

GIVEN n IS A `end of fixed term notices`
GIVETH A NUMBER
DECIDE `the nominated possession day relative to the expiry day` IS
    IF `the lessor's section 70A notice is given in time and not earlier than the expiry day` n
    THEN
        IF `the tenant's section 70A notice is given in time and not earlier than the expiry day` n
        THEN
            IF n's `lessor's possession day relative to the expiry day` LESS THAN n's `tenant's possession day relative to the expiry day`
            THEN n's `lessor's possession day relative to the expiry day`
            ELSE n's `tenant's possession day relative to the expiry day`
        ELSE n's `lessor's possession day relative to the expiry day`
    ELSE
        IF `the tenant's section 70A notice is given in time and not earlier than the expiry day` n
        THEN n's `tenant's possession day relative to the expiry day`
        ELSE 0

GIVEN n IS A `end of fixed term notices`
GIVETH A BOOLEAN
DECIDE `section 70A(7) applies` IF
        `the lessor's section 70A notice is given in time and not earlier than the expiry day` n
    AND n's `the tenant delivered up possession of the premises after the expiry day but before the lessor's possession day`
    AND (
            NOT `the tenant's section 70A notice is given in time and not earlier than the expiry day` n
        OR  n's `lessor's possession day relative to the expiry day` AT MOST n's `tenant's possession day relative to the expiry day`
        )

@ref Residential Tenancies Act 1987 (WA) s.70A
@export The possession day under s.70A as a number of days after the expiry day (0 = expiry day)
GIVEN n IS A `end of fixed term notices` @desc The same s.70A notice facts. Returns 0 if the possession day is the expiry day, a positive number of days after expiry otherwise. Returns 0 if no valid s.70A notice has been given -- in that case the term does not end on the expiry day.
GIVETH A NUMBER
DECIDE `the possession day relative to the expiry day` IS
    IF `section 70A(7) applies` n
    THEN n's `days after the expiry day that the tenant delivered up possession`
    ELSE `the nominated possession day relative to the expiry day` n

GIVEN n IS A `end of fixed term notices`
GIVETH A BOOLEAN
DECIDE `the term of the agreement ends on the expiry day` IF
        `a notice of termination under section 70A has been given` n
    AND `the possession day relative to the expiry day` n EQUALS 0

GIVEN n IS A `end of fixed term notices`
GIVETH A BOOLEAN
DECIDE `the term of the agreement expires on the possession day and not on the expiry day` IF
        `a notice of termination under section 70A has been given` n
    AND `the possession day relative to the expiry day` n GREATER THAN 0

§§§ `70. Effect of notice of termination of periodic tenancy`

DECLARE `periodic tenancy notice` HAS
    `the agreement creates a periodic tenancy` IS A BOOLEAN
    `the period of the notice is not less than the period required under this Act` IS A BOOLEAN
